kind.description: only annotations whose schema is of this kind

q.description: full-text search over tags, prose and the string values of JSON annotations, in web-search syntax: words, "a phrase", -excluded, or. English stemming; case-insensitive.

prop.description: key:value: JSON (kv) annotations whose key (a dotted path for nested objects) has exactly this value, as a string, or as a number, boolean or null when it reads as one, or in an array. Case-sensitive. Repeat for several (all must hold).

tags.description: comma-separated; annotations must have all of them

time_range.description: start-end, in seconds (only for a single sound's annotations)
